# Anne Shirley & Rogerson

- [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md) — Mentor of — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Sunday-school teacher · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) three plain new dresses she has made for her, disappointing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who longs for fashionable puffed sleeves. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Sunday school alone, garnishing her hat with flowers along the way. She attends Miss Rogerson's class feeling out of place, and later reports back to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her day.
>
